neighbours.label: the full stop that closes the givens of a quantitative word problem, just before the question ('Find ...', 'How much ...')
fire: A car accelerates uniformly from rest to 24 m/s in 6 s. Find its acceleration.
A rectangle has a length of 12 cm and a width of 5 cm. Find the length of its diagonal.
A tank holds 800 litres and drains at 25 litres per minute. How long until it is empty?
A block of mass 4 kg rests on a slope inclined at 30 degrees. Determine the normal force.
Maria invests $2,000 at 5% interest compounded yearly. How much will she have after 3 years?
A stone is dropped from a height of 45 m. Calculate the time it takes to hit the ground.
A train covers 180 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed?
A spring stretches 3 cm under a load of 6 N. Find the spring constant.
quiet: The car slowed down near the bridge. Its headlights caught a deer at the edge of the road.
The room was cold and quiet. She lit the fire and sat down with a book.
The tank stood behind the old barn. Rust had eaten through one side of it.
The block of flats was built in 1972. Most of the tenants have lived there for decades.
Maria opened a small bakery last spring. Her bread sells out every morning.
The stone wall runs along the lane. Ivy covers most of it in summer.
The train left the station late. Passengers grumbled as it crawled through the suburbs.
The spring garden was full of tulips. Bees moved slowly between the flowers.
